description.en: A compact navigation button springs into a two-stage menu with photo previews for each destination.
description.zh: 紧凑的导航按钮通过两段弹簧动效展开菜单，每个导航项都带图片预览。

keywords: Knoll 形变 菜单 导航 双阶段 弹簧 侧栏 图片预览 悬停 渐现 morph menu navigation spring hover image preview

useCases: 作品集和工作室网站的导航与目的地预览
Portfolio navigation with destination image previews
discovery.caveat: 示例保留所提供 HTML 的嵌入照片，素材许可尚未核实。菜单项点击后显示示例反馈，接入时可替换成实际导航。

source.implementation: The supplied HTML adapted to a responsive, instance-scoped DOM with keyboard and touch support. The same menu runs in the standalone demo and six framework adapters.
source.license: No separate license was supplied or verified for the original HTML and embedded photos.

notice.en: Source packages preserve the supplied material. Redistribution rights have not been verified.
notice.zh: 代码包保留提交的素材，再分发许可尚未核实。

instructions.en: Open the menu with +. Hover or use Tab to preview a destination. On touch, tap once to preview and again to select. Press Esc to close.
instructions.zh: 点击加号展开菜单。悬停或用 Tab 聚焦导航项可查看预览，触屏轻点一次预览、再点一次选择。按 Esc 收起。
